name: Interviews
description: Transcribes the active interview sequence on this Mac (whisper), finds each answer with the local AI model (Ollama, no internet), groups the answers by the interviewer's question, and puts them on a safe copy: one Chapter marker per question (a broad title, spanning the whole answer) and one Comment marker per small topic. About 20 minutes for an hour of interview. Then Cut & raise answers cuts at each question's answer and moves it up one track, with an adjustment layer named after the question above it (copy only).

inputs.label: Interviewee (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Tahnee, used in the outlines

inputs.label: Audio track (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. A1; empty = all unmuted tracks

actions.label: Find answers and add markers
actions.confirm: Transcribe this sequence and find the answers on this Mac? It takes about 20 minutes for an hour of interview. A safe copy of the sequence is made and the markers go on the copy; the original is not changed.

actions.label: Cut & raise answers
actions.confirm: Cut the clips at the start and end of every question's answer on this TOOLKIT COPY, move each answer up one track and put an adjustment layer named after the question over it? The small topic markers are not cut. Cuts keep video and audio linked. Only a TOOLKIT COPY is changed; nothing is deleted or saved.
